name: teleport-card-transfer
intent: Card compresses into an 8→72px phosphor aperture (200ms), holds empty 120ms, then reconstructs from a matching destination aperture (220ms).
acceptance: Source aperture opens apertureFromPx 8 → apertureToPx 72 during compressMs 200; card clips to circle then vanishes
Mid empty hold emptyHoldMs 120 with card visibility hidden before destination reconstruct
Destination reconstructs only after reconstructMs 220 following empty hold
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows reconstructed destination immediately
